description: This file defines a JSONStorage class that manages thread-safe operations for storing, loading, updating, and filtering JSON data files within a specified directory. It includes methods for appending new items with metadata, updating existing items, retrieving items by ID, and filtering data based on criteria.

classes.name: JSONStorage
classes.description: A thread-safe manager for JSON file storage, supporting load, save, append, update, get_by_id, and filter operations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the JSONStorage with a specified cache directory, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: _get_file_path
methods.description: Constructs the full file path for a given filename, appending '.json' if necessary.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads data from a JSON file, returning an empty list if the file doesn't exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a list of dictionaries to a JSON file with indentation and UTF-8 encoding.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a new item to the JSON file, adding metadata such as 'id' and 'created_at'.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing item identified by 'id' with provided changes, adding 'updated_at' metadata.

methods.name: get_by_id
methods.description: Retrieves a single item by its 'id' from the JSON data.

methods.name: filter
methods.description: Filters items based on provided key-value criteria.
